grh_986c723b46a10ae262d8.title: The Legend
paragraphs: Hardware dealer Ned Austin becomes an unwilling Western celebrity after newspaper publicity transforms him into a legendary retired gunfighter. At first Ned resents the attention, though his business prospers and politicians begin imagining a public career for him. The legend becomes dangerous when three real gunmen arrive to kill Ned and claim the fame for themselves. Ned decides to face them rather than endanger the town, but his friend Billy cleverly points out that only one killer can receive credit and that three men shooting Ned together would only enlarge the legend. The gunmen turn on one another, Ned survives without becoming a killer, and he finally begins to enjoy the advantages of his heroic reputation.

grh_988a348a3866731d07f8.title: One Man Air Force
paragraphs: A dramatization of the wartime career of fighter pilot Don Gentile traces his fascination with flying from reckless youthful aviation in Ohio to combat service against Germany. Once war comes, the instincts that worried his family become disciplined skill in the air, where he earns a reputation as an exceptional fighter ace while remaining personally shy and self-effacing. The broadcast closes with Gentile's mother speaking in person, saying that she came to understand why her son and other American servicemen had to fight to protect their homes.
